## Summary

Describe the problem and the user-visible result.

## Design and compatibility

Describe public API, request-policy, compatibility, security, or failure-mode
decisions. Write `None` when the change has no such effect.

## Validation

List the exact commands and focused tests run locally.

## Documentation

List the README, rustdoc, guides, examples, or changelog entries updated. Explain
why no documentation change is needed when applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue when design discussion was needed.
- [ ] Tests cover the relevant success and failure behavior.
- [ ] Public documentation and examples match the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No real API key, private hostname, customer data, generated artifact, or unrelated change is included.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, strict Clippy, tests, and rustdoc pass locally.
